title: Levels of Neonatal Care
definition: NICUs are leveled I through IV — from basic newborn care to surgical and ECMO capability for the tiniest preemies. Regionalization sends the sickest babies to Level IV centers. Level matches need.
patient_flow: Babies arrive from delivery rooms or transport teams; the sickest go to Level IV NICUs. Care is developmental — clustered handling, dim lights, quiet — while lungs, brains, and guts mature. Parents are trained in feeding, CPR, and monitors over weeks, then room in before discharge home with follow-up clinic tracking development for years.
code_demo:
def apgar_score(appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration):
    """APGAR at 1 and 5 minutes: each 0-2, total 0-10."""
    total = appearance + pulse + grimace + activity + respiration
    band = "critically low" if total < 4 else "fairly low" if total < 7 else "good"
    return f"APGAR {total}/10 -> {band} (7-10 normal, <7 needs support)"
print(apgar_score(2, 2, 1, 1, 1))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
